dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY includes with .INC extension and MCP (message control protocol) DB access pattern typical of JMA ORCA
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with USING SPA-AREA (ORCA subprogram convention)

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - payment certificate / receipt printing for daily patient insurance billing
purpose.summary: ORCHCM31 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that generates payment certificate documents (支払証明書・日別). It reads patient information, insurance combination records, and revenue/collection master data, compiles daily billing statistics, sorts them, and formats output for printing.

notable_features: 19 COPY statements for modular INC includes
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA, ORCSPRTAREA, ORCHCM31AREA parameters
MCP-based database access (ORCA proprietary DB layer, not EXEC SQL)
OCCURS 2001 table for daily billing entries
Shell table copy (CPSHELLTBL.INC) for print output
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoding rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (mojibake). Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 49035 bytes. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system, version history visible in comments (2002-2007). Fixed format with max line length 74.
